new_protocol_template._note: Fill this in for any NEW Redbelly-native protocol before submitting a PR to DefiLlama-Adapters. Delete fields that don't apply.

defillama_api_endpoints._source: Free-tier api.llama.fi routes, cross-verified against three independent third-party API wrappers (github.com/Hati0x/defillama-api, defillama-curl docs, github.com/slurpxbt/defillama_library) that all document the same paths. No API key required for these routes. Price route lives on the separate coins.llama.fi host, not api.llama.fi -- caught as a 404 during live verification (see docs/TESTING.md).
